draft.subject: Next step for Bright Systems
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

Following up on my note last week -- you've got your first project in place, which is the main thing. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so the next step that usually makes it click is getting a teammate in alongside you: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through it with you and answer anything on the Team plan.

Best,
Chidi
